newsitem.title: BRAZIL: RESEARCH ALERT - Cemig upgraded to buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Cemig upgraded to buy.

text.p: -- Credit Lyonnais Securities said in a statement it has upgraded Minas Gerais state-owned power firm Cemig to buy from hold.
-- Analyst Rosana Aldworth said she expects a block sale of a 33 percent voting stake in Cemig to a foreign operator to take place within the next 45 to 60 days.
-- Also, she said Cemig's fourth quarter results are expected to "significantly exceed our earlier forecasts."
-- She raised Cemig's 1996 EPS estimate by 22 percent to 2.28 reais from 1.86 reais.
-- Aldworth set a year-end target price for the stock at 65 reais, an upside of 40 percent from current price levels.
-- Cemig preferred was trading at 49.30 reais, up 2.28 percent.
